description: STRESS LAB (OUTDOOR): west returns to Lifecycle & Restore. Starts quiet. stress_low = rain, one cloud and one fire/smoke/light group; stress_high = seven weather/atmosphere effects, four cloud layers and four fire/smoke/light groups. stress_quiet stops/hides the persistent load; allow 30 seconds for residuals. stress_hide/show toggles fire assemblies. stress_burst fires four finite-lived sources; stress_debris separately creates long-lived rubble until room departure. stress_checkpoint marks a resource observation. Use CommandSequence/StressLab.txt from a NEW Shelter game; see STRESS_LAB_COVERAGE.md. No background timers run.
